answer: Jury diversity breaks first. Three seats must come from three operator clusters, and no identity may audit its own recruit, so a large farm cannot fill a panel alone. Proof expires unless renewed by fresh work each epoch. A mesa of clones looks wide and holds nothing. The trellis only supports a vine that keeps growing, and the canyon between two clusters is the part an attacker cannot buy. Price it as a permanent recruiting cost, not a one-time bond.
